== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[It Can Wait (Japanese ESB Two-Player)|It Can Wait]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=100690 Star Wars Collectors Archive item 100690], [https://theswca.com/imgup/100690-1.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(90, 50, 680, 930)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>824182121ae64490d93ff6392435dbe7eaf49a00949f044bb5f930554f68382a</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
